what: Which database engine the CONSTRUCTION may write to, and which one it may never touch. Anything on `allowed` is a construction engine; `company` is the holding and is refused outright. Read by tests/global-teardown.ts (the battery refuses to start against the company), tests/construction-engine.ts and db/seed/build-seed.ts.
